question: What is the minimum vertically aggregated state representation that preserves hydrologically relevant memory of a 160 cm B01 Richards column, and which closure is then required to propagate that state?

diagnostic_state_scale.coordinate: fixed-layer mean theta, information-equivalent to exact layer storage for fixed layer thickness
diagnostic_state_scale.role: diagnostic state-neighborhood scale only, never an application tolerance

partition_freeze_rationale.L_family: Nested terminal refinement tests the prior active-lower-zone hypothesis without searching the new response results.
partition_freeze_rationale.U_family: Same-dimension controls distribute state information approximately uniformly on the immutable 10 cm Reference grid.
partition_freeze_rationale.L6_rule: L6 extends the pre-existing L2/L3/L4 nested lower-zone ladder upward by two fixed 10 cm layers; it is not selected from the future-response artifact.

future_response_common_cohort.source: exact 41 response-blind start states already frozen by LARE-RS1-GW-P2 selection
future_response_common_cohort.pair_universe: all unordered cross-history pairs among the 41 starts

response_vector: piecewise-constant reconstructed theta profile RMSE and max-absolute error as secondary current-state diagnostics

error_decomposition.state_information_error: future-response ambiguity between full states that are close only after projection to the frozen layer state
error_decomposition.closure_error: difference introduced when a frozen reduced state is propagated by a specified inter-layer closure; not part of A1
error_decomposition.numerical_discretization_error: difference caused by solving Richards on a coarser spatial discretization; represented separately by same-partition CoRichards where qualified

closure_families_frozen_for_successor.role: Darcy flux from constitutive heads at layer-average state and centroid gradient, with separately declared conductivity averaging
quasi-steady within-layer profile reconstruction constrained by layer storage before face flux evaluation
only after evidence shows layer storage alone insufficient; requires separately preregistered additional gradient or moment state

falsification_rules: If an added smart layer does not reduce state aliasing or future-response ambiguity relative to the lower-dimensional nested member, it has no demonstrated information value in this domain.
If a uniform same-dimension control is noninferior across every declared ambiguity component, the active-zone placement hypothesis is not supported at that dimension.
If L6 still shows material future-response ambiguity at the 1x diagnostic radius, layer-storage-only state is not established sufficient for this domain.
No representation is application-accepted without independently sourced application tolerances.
next_if_A1_supports_layer_storage_state: Freeze one or more surviving representations and compare C_LARE_TAYLOR, C_DARCY_CENTROID and C_QS_PROFILE without changing the state representation.
next_if_A1_rejects_layer_storage_state: Preregister an additional physically interpretable state such as gradient/moment or front position before any new closure fitting.

pre_execution_amendment.change: Explicitly preregister current-profile reconstruction diagnostics already implied by the requested evaluation vector.
pre_execution_amendment.scientific_effect: No partition, radius, future-response metric, acceptance rule or candidate selection changed.
